description: This file contains utility functions for generating sample data for Mattermost, including users, teams, channels, posts, reactions, and replies, used for data import or testing purposes.

methods.name: randomPastTime
methods.description: Generates a past timestamp within a specified number of seconds.

methods.name: sortedRandomDates
methods.description: Creates a sorted list of random past timestamps.

methods.name: randomEmoji
methods.description: Returns a random emoji string from a predefined list.

methods.name: randomReaction
methods.description: Creates a random reaction data structure associated with a user and timestamp.

methods.name: randomReply
methods.description: Creates a random reply data structure associated with a user and timestamp.

methods.name: randomMessage
methods.description: Generates a random message string with various formats.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a sample user data structure with randomized attributes and team/channel memberships.

methods.name: createTeam
methods.description: Creates a sample team data structure with randomized attributes.

methods.name: createChannel
methods.description: Creates a sample channel within a team with randomized attributes.

methods.name: createPost
methods.description: Creates a sample post within a team and channel with randomized content and reactions.

methods.name: createDirectChannel
methods.description: Creates a direct message channel with specified members.

methods.name: createDirectPost
methods.description: Creates a direct message post with randomized content and reactions.
